note: Uncompressed sizes are what `docker images` reports. Compressed sizes are what a cold `docker pull` transfers. Base-image rows are published measurements. Streamlit recipe rows are a composed example of one app; only the Streamlit tutorial total is a published image size.

base_images.label: python:3.12
base_images.uncompressed_source: sluofoss, python:3.12 Debian, Dec 2024 (1.01 GB); testdriven.io 3.12.2-bookworm 1.02 GB

streamlit_runtime.source: Residual of Streamlit's published 1.02 GB tutorial image after subtracting slim (130) and build-essential/curl/git (150). Dominated by pyarrow; Spatial Workflow measured pyarrow at 156 MB inside a 771 MB Streamlit map image.

build_tools.source: Streamlit tutorial installs build-essential, curl, and git into the final slim image. testdriven.io measured gcc alone at +103 MB (259 vs 156 MB) on a smaller Python app.

fat_debian_extra.source: python:3.12 (1010) minus python:3.12-slim (130). The default tag ships gcc, g++, make, headers, git, wget, and other build packages the slim tag strips. testdriven.io: bookworm 1.02 GB vs slim 130 MB, 1,711 vs 509 commands (tchesnokov).

nodejs_npm.source: Estimate for Debian `apt-get install nodejs npm` without --no-install-recommends. Not a measured layer from this repo.

apt_lists.source: Flytekit maintainers measured 20–30 MB from uncleaned /var/lib/apt/lists (PR 1927). Rounded up.

jupyter_dev.source: Estimate for pip-installing jupyter, pytest, and black on top of the Streamlit stack. JupyterLab trees commonly land in the 150–250 MB range.

pip_cache.source: pip keeps wheels under /root/.cache/pip. Flyte agent image: 813 MB. TVM CI: 700 MB CPU / 1.6 GB GPU. 180 MB is a modest stand-in for this app's wheels, not those CI images.

node_modules.source: Estimate for `npm install` of a small React/webpack/TypeScript tree. Typical node_modules is 150–300 MB. The bloated Dockerfile actually runs npm install; this number is the size used in the figure, not a build from this machine.

tutorial.label: Streamlit tutorial
tutorial.kind: published total (1.02 GB); stacked split is estimated
tutorial.dockerfile: Streamlit docs, python:3.12-slim + build-essential + curl + git

compression_ratio_for_estimates.note: Official python tags compress to 0.32 (slim) through 0.39 (default). Composed app images use 0.35 times uncompressed as a pull-size stand-in. They are not Hub measurements.

pull_model.source: Reddy, University of Wisconsin–Madison honors thesis, 2026. Combined shaped dataset, N=48. pull_ms = 4391 + 7794 × (compressed_MB / bandwidth_Mbit). Testbed is Kind + a local registry with tc shaping, not Docker Hub itself.
caveats: Linear in compressed size at a fixed bandwidth, plus a ~4.4 s intercept for registry/TLS/manifest work.
Fit is on 5 and 20 Mbit/s. The 100 Mbit/s line is the same equation outside the fit.
On a fast unconstrained link, unpacking large layers can dominate (Sandboxer: node:22 spend was mostly decompress/write, ~26 MB/s end-to-end).
Tiny images are round-trip bound. Sandboxer: alpine:3.20 at 3.6 MB still took 1.6 s on Docker Hub because of token, manifest, and config requests.
